name: Sloppity Bilepiper

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: The Sloppity Bilepiper may use Ruin actions and has 2 personal Ruin.

abilities.name: Frightful Form
abilities.text: Anyone that can see this threat must make a DN 4 Fear Test.

abilities.name: Disease of Mirth
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. All characters without the Mark of Nurgle keyword gain the Exhausted condition. On their turn, they may take a Free Action to make a DN 2 Resolve Test to remove the condition.

abilities.name: Jolly Gutpipes
abilities.text: Spent 1 Ruin. All characters with the NURGLE keyword are immediately cured of all Conditions.

determination: Daemonic Determination: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 9d6. Daemons can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds. Any Wounds negated by Determination are ignored instead of being converted to Shock.
note: Weapon Skill 10 is printed twice in SKILLS. Marotter prints no AP and no range, so it is stored with range [1].
